sentences.text: behold the lamb beat Bo Girds by 5.34, an upset of a team that sat 2nd before the week.
Recent add Germie Bernard, a week 5 waiver claim, was the decider with 20.2, and without him, that is a loss.

The Game Changer is Germie Bernard, a recent add who scored 20.2 for behold the lamb.
It was an upset: behold the lamb came in 11th and beat Bo Girds by 5.34.
Without Bernard, that is a loss, and at 12.07 over projection he is the margin driver who decided it.

Brock ‘N’ Roll, now 6-6 and sitting exactly at the cut, has Davante Adams and Mike Evans now listed Out, while Lil Fridge has Romeo Doubs now listed IR.

Maye d'force B with U beat Amon-Ra Dawg Your Team by 9.51, and the decider on the winning side was Isaiah Likely, a tight end who put up 20.9.

Recent add Dalton Kincaid and Jaylen Waddle are both now listed Questionable, and Amon-Ra Dawg Your Team sits at 4-8, 2 games below the cut, which needs no commentary.
behold the lamb was 11th before this week and beat Bo Girds anyway, an upset by 5.34.

Bo Girds's starters dropped passes worth about 17.8, so the drops cost the game, and the losing streak is now 2.
London Cooking beat To Infinity and Bijan by 66.4, and the 46.08 was a season low for the losers.
Bijan Robinson scored 6.3 for a team named after him, 16.78 under projection.
The trade shopping went about as well: recent add Ladd McConkey scored 2.2 and is now listed Out (Concussion), and recent add Terry McLaurin scored 3.2 and is now listed Out (Knee).
All You Need Is Love beat Pukancun on 3 by 12.95, and Tre Tucker decided it with 24.2.
Without Tucker, that is a loss.

Hampton and Pollard started for Amon-Ra Dawg Your Team and put up 13.5, not enough to change its result, though still 13.5 more than the other side got from the deal.
That gap clears the 12.95 margin in the other matchup, so the trade cost Pukancun on 3 the game, which is an efficient way to lose twice in one transaction.
To Infinity and Bijan sent Dalton Kincaid to Amon-Ra Dawg Your Team for Kenyon Sadiq.
Sadiq scored 1.7 on the bench for To Infinity and Bijan, while Kincaid put up 7.3 for his new team, which is the kind of exchange rate nobody brags about.
In To Infinity and Bijan's matchup, that 7.3 gap sat against a 66.4 margin, so the trade changed nothing, which is the nicest thing anyone can say about it.
Pukancun on 3 sent Ladd McConkey and Rhamondre Stevenson to To Infinity and Bijan for Cam Skattebo and Nico Collins.
Pukancun on 3 got 9.4 from Nico Collins and 0 from Cam Skattebo, which is half a trade.
To Infinity and Bijan started its new pair for 5.8 combined, a 3.6-point gap that changed neither result.
Bo Girds sent Patrick Mahomes and Brian Robinson to To Infinity and Bijan for Lamar Jackson, who promptly scored 0 on the Bo Girds bench.
Mahomes started for To Infinity and Bijan and scored 11.48, a gap above the 5.34 margin in the Bo Girds matchup, so the trade decided it.
For To Infinity and Bijan, the same gap changed nothing against a margin of 66.4, which is a lot of margin for one quarterback to matter.
Unsolicited Dak Picks sent Bhayshul Tuten and Garrett Wilson to Amon-Ra Dawg Your Team for Devaughn Vele and Josh Jacobs.
Tuten scored 22.7 in his new colors, while Josh Jacobs scored 0 on the Unsolicited Dak Picks bench.
Devaughn Vele added 5.7, also from the bench, which is where Unsolicited Dak Picks parked everything it got in the deal.
The league median landed at 106.83, and Lil Fridge cleared it by 19.97, as a first-place team tends to.
To Infinity and Bijan put up a season low of 46.08 and missed the median by 60.75, which is less a miss than a different sport.
Bo Girds and Amon-Ra Dawg Your Team landed on opposite sides of the line by the same 2.79, so close and yet so 4-8.
Unsolicited Dak Picks also found a season low at 81.47, an odd week to bottom out for a team 2 games below the cut.
